newsitem.title: USA: Delta, American offer holiday fares.
newsitem.headline: Delta, American offer holiday fares.

text.p: Delta Air Lines Inc and AMR Corp's American Airlines said on Tuesday that they are offering special holiday fares.
Delta said it is offering round-trip travel for $96 to $196 on Christmas Eve and Christmas Day.

American Airlines said it and its affiliate American Eagle are offering fares from $88 to $298 for round-trip travel within the two-day periods of December 24 and December 25, 1996 or December 31 and January 1, 1997.
